description: This source file defines the DeviceStatusService class, which provides various device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and system info, utilizing iOS system APIs and custom payload structures.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A service class providing device status information like battery, thermal, storage, network, and system info with asynchronous and synchronous methods, conforming to DeviceStatusServicing protocol.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously gathers battery, thermal, storage, network, and uptime status and returns as OpenClawDeviceStatusPayload.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns device information including device name, model, system version, app version, locale, and build info.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current battery level and state, and low power mode status.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current thermal state of the device.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Calculates total, free, and used storage space on the device.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Provides a default build string if the app build info is empty.
